stem.text: Four mixtures are added to four separate $50\,\text{cm}^3$ samples of water and stirred.
Which mixture results in a solution with the highest pH?

A.text: 1.0 g of aluminium oxide and 1.0 g of aluminium chloride

B.text: 1.0 g of magnesium oxide and 1.0 g of magnesium chloride

C.text: 1.0 g of phosphorus oxide and 1.0 g of phosphorus chloride

D.text: 1.0 g of silicon dioxide and 1.0 g of silicon chloride
